# rwx_group_user_membership (Resource)

Manages one direct manual user membership in a group. Other users, inherited membership, and directory-owned membership are preserved. Import reads only the manual contribution; inherited or directory-only membership cannot be imported. Manual user membership changes are rejected in SCIM-managed organizations. Requires `org:access` to read and `group:manage` on the group to add or remove membership.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rwx_group" "engineering" {
  name = "engineering"
}

data "rwx_user" "engineer" {
  email = "engineer@example.com"
}

resource "rwx_group_user_membership" "engineer" {
  group_id = rwx_group.engineering.id
  user_id  = data.rwx_user.engineer.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The ID of the group. Changing this replaces the membership.
- `user_id` (String) The user ID of an existing active user in the organization, not an identity ID or organization-user ID. Changing this replaces the membership.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The membership identity, in group-id/user-id format.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import rwx_group_user_membership.engineer group-id/user-id
```
